title: B1 · L3 — Past perfect simple
topic: Past perfect simple: had + past participle
description: El past perfect simple ('had + participio') se usa para hablar de una acción que ocurrió ANTES de otra acción o momento en el pasado.

questions.prompt: Situación: cuentas por qué llegaste tarde al trabajo esta mañana.
questions.question: Complete: 'When I arrived at the station, the train ___.'
questions.explanation: Dos acciones pasadas: primero se fue el tren, después llegaste tú. Para el evento MÁS ANTIGUO usamos past perfect ('had left'); para el más reciente, past simple ('arrived'). Error típico del hispanohablante: usar dos past simples ('the train left') que sugiere que se fue justo cuando llegaste, no antes.
examples: When we got home, the party had already finished. → nosotros llegamos después
She had cooked dinner before we arrived. → cocinó primero

questions.statement: The past perfect is used to show that one past action happened before another past action.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. El past perfect ('had + participio') es el 'pasado del pasado' — sitúa una acción anterior a otro punto pasado. Requiere SIEMPRE un segundo evento pasado como referencia, explícito o implícito. Nunca se usa solo en aislamiento.
examples: By the time I woke up, he had already left. → 'left' anterior a 'woke up'
She had finished her homework before dinner. → orden claro con 'before'

questions.prompt: Le explicas a un amigo por qué te quedaste fuera anoche.
questions.question: Choose: 'I couldn't get into the house because I ___ my keys.'
questions.explanation: 'Had forgotten' es la CAUSA anterior de 'couldn't get in'. El past perfect explica el 'porqué' cuando este ocurrió antes del evento principal. Contraste: si dijeras 'because I forgot my keys' (past simple), sugiere que olvidaste las llaves en el momento de llegar, no antes.
examples: He was starving because he hadn't eaten all day. → causa anterior
She was exhausted because she had worked late the night before. → explica el estado

questions.text: By the time we arrived, they had already started the meeting.
questions.explanation: Nota la elisión de 'had' → 'they'd already started' es lo natural en habla. 'By the time' se pronuncia rápido, casi como una sola palabra. 'Already' entre 'had' y el participio es la posición canónica y suele ir con acento fuerte para marcar la molestia/sorpresa.
examples: By the time she called, I'd gone to bed. → contracción 'd habitual
By the time the film ended, half the audience had left. → misma estructura

questions.prompt: Identifica la única frase donde el past perfect está bien usado.
questions.question: Which sentence uses the past perfect correctly?
options: I had eaten dinner and then I go to bed.
After I had finished work, I went home.
I had gone to the shop yesterday.
questions.explanation: El past perfect necesita OTRO evento pasado como ancla. 'After I had finished work, I went home' tiene ambos: past perfect (had finished) + past simple (went). Errores: (a) mezcla presente/pasado, (c) past perfect solo sin referencia, (d) estructura imposible (had been + infinitivo).
examples: After she had left, I called her. → orden claro
Before we ate, we had washed our hands. → past perfect anterior

questions.prompt: Empareja el concepto con su descripción:

pairs.right: before / after / by the time / when

pairs.left: Emphasizes completion before another past event

questions.explanation: El past perfect es un pasado 'anterior' al pasado principal. Los marcadores más frecuentes son 'before, after, by the time, when, already, just, never...until'. Recuerda: el past perfect NO expresa presente, siempre relaciona dos momentos pasados.
examples: He had left before I arrived. → orden marcado con 'before'
By the time she called, I had eaten. → 'by the time' fija el momento posterior

questions.prompt: Explicas por qué tu amiga no quiso ir al cine contigo.
questions.question: Complete: 'She didn't want to see the film because she ___ it before.'
questions.explanation: El rechazo (didn't want, past simple) se explica por una experiencia previa (had seen, past perfect). Con 'before' como marcador temporal referido al pasado, el past perfect es casi obligatorio para dejar claro que ocurrió antes del evento principal.
examples: He didn't order the pasta because he had tried it before and hated it. → causa anterior
I didn't tell her because she had already heard the news. → información previa

questions.target: When I finally got to the airport, my flight had already taken off — I couldn't believe it.
questions.explanation: Situación: cuentas una anécdota de viaje frustrante a amigos. Ordena dos eventos pasados: llegar (past simple) + despegar (past perfect anterior). 'Finally' y 'couldn't believe it' añaden emoción natural, como se cuentan las historias reales. Contracción 'couldn't' obligatoria en habla.
examples: When we opened the door, the guests had already left — awkward. → sorpresa narrada
When she called, I'd just finished dinner, so I could chat. → conexión de eventos

questions.statement: 'I had never eaten sushi until I visited Japan last year' is grammatically correct.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. La estructura 'had never + participio + until + past simple' expresa una experiencia acumulada nula HASTA un momento del pasado. Es un uso muy típico del past perfect para primeras veces. 'Never' va entre 'had' y el participio.
examples: I had never seen snow until I moved to Canada. → primera vez en el pasado
She had never travelled abroad until she was 25. → experiencia acumulada nula

questions.prompt: Recuerdas la primera vez que viste una película de terror.
questions.question: Complete: 'It was the first time I ___ a horror film.'
questions.explanation: Después de 'It was the first/second/third time...' referido al pasado, se usa past perfect para la experiencia acumulada hasta ese momento. Regla paralela con el presente: 'It's the first time I've watched' (present perfect); en pasado se corre un tiempo atrás.
examples: It was the first time she had visited us — she loved the house. → primera vez pasada
It was the third time he had failed the test, poor guy. → experiencias acumuladas

questions.text: She had lived in Paris for years before she moved to London.
questions.explanation: Nota la contracción típica en habla: 'She'd lived in Paris'. La 'd' de 'had' apenas se oye entre consonantes. 'For years' se pronuncia enlazado ('foryears'). Estructura clásica de biografías: 'had + verbo + for + periodo + before + past simple'.
examples: He'd worked there for a decade before he retired. → biografía profesional
They'd known each other for years before they got married. → antecedente largo

questions.prompt: Entras al salón y encuentras juguetes por todas partes.
questions.question: Choose the natural option: 'The room was a mess because the kids ___ with their toys.'
questions.explanation: Past perfect continuous ('had been playing') explica un ESTADO pasado (mess) como resultado de una acción prolongada anterior. Foco en la duración/proceso previo. Contraste: 'had played' (simple) solo diría que jugaron; 'had been playing' subraya el rato largo que estuvieron jugando.
examples: The grass was wet because it had been raining all morning. → proceso anterior
He was out of breath because he'd been running. → causa prolongada

questions.statement: You must always use past perfect whenever two events happen in the past.
questions.explanation: FALSO. Cuando el orden ya está claro por marcadores como 'before/after' o por el contexto, dos past simples son perfectamente naturales. El past perfect se reserva para cuando el orden podría ser ambiguo o cuando quieres enfatizar el 'antes'.
examples: After I ate, I went out. → dos past simples, orden claro con 'after'
I had eaten before I went out. → past perfect enfatiza el orden

questions.prompt: En medio del día caes en la cuenta de algo.
questions.question: Complete: 'I realised I ___ my wallet at home.'
questions.explanation: Verbos de percepción/descubrimiento (realise, discover, notice, remember, find out) suelen ir en past simple + past perfect para lo descubierto/pensado. La cartera se dejó ANTES de que te dieras cuenta. Error típico: usar dos past simples y perder el orden.
examples: He discovered that someone had stolen his bike. → descubrimiento + acción anterior
She noticed that the door had been left open. → percepción de un hecho previo

questions.target: By the time I finished university, I'd already found a job — I was really lucky.
questions.explanation: Situación: cuentas tu trayectoria en una entrevista o coffee chat. Estructura clave B1: 'By the time + past simple, subject + had already + participio'. Contracción 'I'd' obligatoria. 'I was really lucky' añade un cierre humano y natural.
examples: By the time she was 30, she'd travelled to 20 countries — pretty impressive. → hito acumulado
By the time we got home, the kids had gone to sleep, thankfully. → orden claro
